diagnostics: Normalized exact and nearest-neighbor similarity audit
topic_groups: 12 label-free text clusters from official 8000-row training partition; three GroupKFold folds
blend_scaling: Component decision scores divided by their own training-score standard deviation
candidate_selection: Among candidates whose official validation AUROC is at least the existing 0.977012, prefer the highest mean training-only topic-held-out AUROC
selection_note: Rule recorded after official-validation results were seen but before topic-fold comparisons completed; this audit is exploratory, not a preregistered confirmation study
test_use: Aggregate unlabeled diagnostics only; test labels unavailable; no external LLM API predicts test labels
public_score_use: The existing 0.85994 motivated an audit; no new candidate public scores are available or used to select blend weights
